Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that fetches and normalizes federated user profile claims using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
```python
import requests

def fetch_normalized_profile(access_token: str) -> dict:
    """
    Fetches federated user profile from Google and normalizes claims.
    """
    url = "https://openidconnect.googleapis.com/v1/userinfo"
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {access_token}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
    response.raise_for_status()
    user_info = response.json()

    normalized = {
        "sub": user_info.get("sub"),
        "email": user_info.get("email"),
        "email_verified": user_info.get("email_verified"),
        "name": user_info.get("name"),
        "given_name": user_info.get("given_name"),
        "family_name": user_info.get("family_name"),
        "picture": user_info.get("picture"),
        "locale": user_info.get("locale"),
        "provider": "google"
    }
    return {k: v for k, v in normalized.items() if v is not None}
```
